results.text: Repeated doses of captopril induce airway hyperresponsiveness by modulating the TRPV1 receptor in rats. Although TRPV1 receptors play an essential role in the adverse effects on the airways following captopril treatment, there is no available evidence of their involvement in treatment regimens involving repeated doses of captopril.
